from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

atoms = []   # (symbol)
bonds = []   # (i,j,order)

def add(sym):
    atoms.append(sym); return len(atoms)-1

def B(i,j,o=1): bonds.append((i,j,o))

# ---- Cp* ring
cp = [add('C') for _ in range(5)]
cpme = [add('C') for _ in range(5)]
for k in range(5):
    B(cp[k], cp[(k+1)%5], 1 if k%2 else 2)
    B(cp[k], cpme[k], 1)
Ir = add('Ir')
for k in range(5): B(Ir, cp[k], 1)

# ---- P and methyls
P = add('P')
B(Ir, P, 1)
pme1 = add('C'); pme2 = add('C')
B(P, pme1, 1); B(P, pme2, 1)

# ---- central ring A (1,2,3-trisubstituted): A1 ipso-P, A2 ipso-ringC, A6 ipso-ringB
A = [add('C') for _ in range(6)]
for k in range(6): B(A[k], A[(k+1)%6], 1 if k%2 else 2)
B(P, A[0], 1)

# ---- ring B (3,5-di-tBu phenyl), B1 ipso attached to A[5]
Bc = [add('C') for _ in range(6)]
for k in range(6): B(Bc[k], Bc[(k+1)%6], 1 if k%2 else 2)
B(A[5], Bc[0], 1)
def tbu(parent):
    c = add('C'); B(parent, c, 1)
    ms = [add('C') for _ in range(3)]
    for m in ms: B(c, m, 1)
    return c, ms
tbB3 = tbu(Bc[2]); tbB5 = tbu(Bc[4])

# ---- ring C: V1..V6 ; V1 attached to A[1]; V1=V6, V2=V3, V4=V5
V = [add('C') for _ in range(6)]
B(V[0], V[5], 2); B(V[1], V[2], 2); B(V[3], V[4], 2)
B(V[0], V[1], 1); B(V[2], V[3], 1); B(V[4], V[5], 1)
B(A[1], V[0], 1)
tbV3 = tbu(V[2])
# CMe2-CH2-Ir arm on V4
cq = add('C'); B(V[3], cq, 1)
cm1 = add('C'); cm2 = add('C'); B(cq, cm1, 1); B(cq, cm2, 1)
ch2 = add('C'); B(cq, ch2, 1); B(ch2, Ir, 1)
# eta2 olefin coordination
B(Ir, V[0], 1); B(Ir, V[5], 1)

# ---- explicit hydrogens
def addH(idx, n):
    hs = [add('H') for _ in range(n)]
    for h in hs: B(idx, h, 1)
    return hs

for m in cpme+[pme1,pme2]: addH(m,3)
for c,ms in [tbB3,tbB5,tbV3]:
    for m in ms: addH(m,3)
for m in [cm1,cm2]: addH(m,3)
addH(ch2,2)
for idx in [A[2],A[3],A[4]]: addH(idx,1)
for idx in [Bc[1],Bc[3],Bc[5]]: addH(idx,1)
for idx in [V[1],V[5]]: addH(idx,1)

mol = Chem.RWMol()
for s in atoms:
    mol.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(s))
for i,j,o in bonds:
    mol.AddBond(i,j, Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m = mol.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES)
print('natoms', m.GetNumAtoms())
from rdkit.Chem import rdDistGeom
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolTransforms
ok = rdDistGeom.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=0xf00d, useRandomCoords=True, maxAttempts=20)
print('embed', ok)
conf = m.GetConformer()
with open('init.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write('%d\ninit\n'%m.GetNumAtoms())
    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write('%s %.6f %.6f %.6f\n'%(atoms[i], p.x,p.y,p.z))
# report key distances
import numpy as np
xyz = np.array([[conf.GetAtomPosition(i).x, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).y, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).z] for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms())])
def d(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j])
print('Ir-P', d(Ir,P), 'Ir-CH2', d(Ir,ch2), 'Ir-V1', d(Ir,V[0]), 'Ir-V6', d(Ir,V[5]))
print('Ir-Cp', [round(d(Ir,c),2) for c in cp])
np.save('idx.npy', {'Ir':Ir,'P':P,'ch2':ch2,'V':V,'cp':cp,'A':A,'Bc':Bc,'cq':cq}, allow_pickle=True)
